descriptionChirho: Qal sense: to be straight, right, or pleasing in someone's eyes; used of actions, words, or situations that are approved or considered proper.
Qal sense: to go straight ahead in a physical direction, to proceed in a direct path without turning aside.
Piel sense: to make straight or smooth, to direct or guide along a path, to arrange or set in order; includes both literal leveling and figurative moral directing.
Pual (passive) sense: to be made level, smoothed, or evenly spread; the passive counterpart of the Piel causative.

labelChirho: cause to be straight, direct gaze
descriptionChirho: Hifil sense: to cause to go straight, to make level, or to direct one's eyes or attention forward; causative action of straightening or directing.
